1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Penagih dan

Penyalah Guna Dadah dan Bahan (Rawatan dan Pemulihan) (Borang) 2025.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 22 Ogos 2025.

Borang

2. (1) Bagi maksud peruntukan Akta, borang yang digunakan berkaitan dengan

mana-mana perkara di bawah Akta adalah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Kandungan Borang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual hendaklah sebagaimana

yang ditentukan oleh Menteri dari semasa ke semasa.

Pembatalan

3. Kaedah-Kaedah Penagih Dadah (Rawatan dan Pemulihan) (Borang-Borang) 1998

[P.U. (A) 310/1998] dibatalkan.

DRUG AND SUBSTANCE DEPENDANTS AND MISUSERS

(TREATMENT AND REHABILITATION) ACT 1983

DRUG AND SUBSTANCE DEPENDANTS AND MISUSERS

(TREATMENT AND REHABILITATION) (FORMS) RULES 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 28(1) of the Drug and Substance

Dependants and Misusers (Treatment and Rehabilitation) Act 1983 [Act 283],

the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Drug and Substance Dependants and

Misusers (Treatment and Rehabilitation) (Forms) Rules 2025.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 22 August 2025.

Forms

2. (1) For the purposes of the provisions of the Act, the forms to be used

in connection with any matter under the Act are as specified in the Schedule.

(2) The contents of the Forms specified in the Schedule shall be as determined

by the Minister from time to time.

Revocation

3. The Drug Dependants (Treatment and Rehabilitation) (Forms) Rules 1998

[P.U. (A) 310/1998] are revoked.
